budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: A three-person crew must collect three fragile survey capsules from marked river buoys and bank them at its home berth. The skiff retains velocity until counter-thrust or braking changes it. Walking crew, filled corner tanks and loaded capsules change its balance; loose capsules slide toward the low edge and can be lost. Two reusable clips can secure capsules, while cliffs, reef collision and severe imbalance damage the hull.
task.natural_termination: Hull exhaustion, then any capsule lost, then all three banked. Otherwise time limit 192. Natural success/failure has priority over horizon.
task.interaction: A crew member walks to the upper scoop, moving mass upward; a colleague shifts ballast downward before a capsule can satisfy the loading balance check. A loaded capsule changes torque. The clip worker must reach its current deck cell while the helm keeps the boat stationary or navigates safely; securing it prevents gravity motion but preserves its contribution to torque. A helm command changes persistent velocity. Waiting does not stop travel; a later opposite impulse or brake is necessary before stationary sampling or banking. A periodic current impulse can introduce lateral motion. The crew can read tide phase and centre terrain, but the proper correction depends on existing velocity and available fuel. When two clips are occupied, collecting another capsule requires retaining safe balance, releasing a clip or banking earlier. The reward does not directly prescribe one of those strategies. Walking, filling tanks and moving loose capsules alter a shared torque calculation, so independent locally sensible actions can jointly cause an edge loss or structural damage.
task.observation_access: All physical quantities public; only identity one-hot differs by crew. Flat observations have exactly 1939 columns.
task.action_mask_semantics: Masks permit attempts whose outcome depends on simultaneous partner/opponent actions. Static bounds/roles/resources are masked; raw transition rules resolve occupancy, new-object availability, adjacency and conflicts. Attempt validity does not guarantee an effect.

reward_definition.team_reward_formula: For each active transition, r = newly_banked_count + 2*I(new natural success) - I(new natural failure) - 0.02*hull_units_lost - 0.001. Return [r,r,r] as float32.
reward_definition.natural_failure: Reason 2 or 3, selected on this transition.
reward_definition.horizon: A horizon truncation has no invented success/failure bonus; it retains the ordinary bank/damage/step reward of that transition.
reward_definition.accounting: A capsule can yield a banking reward only on its 1->2 status change. Clips, filling/draining tanks and observations yield no direct reward.
reward_definition.empirical_status: These are proposed reward rules. No reward values, completion rates or learning results have been observed.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Committed transition event codes, gated by event_active; payloads describe actual accepted changes, with documented force/rejected-attempt exceptions.

kinds.name: crew_move
kinds.from_to: old and accepted new deck cell
kinds.visual_lifetime: 0.75 transition interval; interpolate only accepted cells

kinds.name: thrust
kinds.from_to: old world centre to old centre plus command direction; a force arrow, not travel

kinds.name: vessel_move
kinds.from_to: old and accepted new world centre
kinds.visual_lifetime: 0.8 interval; hull, crew and cargo translate together

kinds.name: collision
kinds.from_to: old world centre and rejected candidate centre
kinds.visual_lifetime: 0.5 interval; cross at blocked direction, hull remains at accepted position

kinds.name: sample_load
kinds.from_to: source buoy in world space to accepted tray in deck space

kinds.name: sample_bank
kinds.from_to: previous cargo deck cell to home berth in world space

kinds.name: sample_slide
kinds.from_to: old and accepted new deck cell

kinds.name: sample_loss
kinds.from_to: old deck cell and off-deck proposed cell, both in deck space
kinds.visual_lifetime: 0.8 interval; endpoint is a recorded loss location

kinds.name: clip_attach
kinds.visual_lifetime: 0.4 interval; persistent strap then follows capsule_pinned

kinds.name: overstrain
kinds.visual_lifetime: 0.5 interval; stress flash driven by committed damage

kinds.name: episode_end
kinds.visual_lifetime: one new-event reveal; persistent banner subsequently derives from done/reason

native_event_definitions.replay_rule: Deduplicate tick/slot identities; interpolate actual stage endpoints only. Absorbing snapshots preserve events and must not replay them.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
